title: The Lord Will Not Forget Them!Māori Seers and The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints in Nineteenth-Century New Zealand
author: Robert Joseph
abstract: Abstract: This essay demonstrates that the key prophetic matakite dreams and visions of at least the nine nineteenth-century East Coast Māori seers appear to have been (and should continue to be) fulfilled surprisingly by the coming of The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints to New Zealand. There are lessons for current and future Latter-day Saint leaders and missionaries to reflect on this little-known history on the nineteenth-century Māori conversions to the restored Church.
